name: calle-canopy
description: Hazard-triggered welfare roll call: when a heat, flood, outage or smoke alert fires, CALL-E phones every opted-in vulnerable person in the area, triages them, escalates the ones who need help to a human, and writes the after-action report.

scripts.plan: node --import tsx src/cli.ts plan --registry data/registry.sample.csv --hazard heat --area "Maricopa County, AZ" --dry-run
scripts.demo: node --import tsx src/cli.ts run --registry data/registry.sample.csv --hazard heat --area "Maricopa County, AZ" --dry-run
